title: Canary-secret test over the service log for the main failure paths
goal: A committed test drives each failure path with canary secrets and checks the log and inbox never contain them
acceptance: Test committed first; it fails on main if any path leaks, and the record says which
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: the report sizes the whole at 1.5 h. Not a measurement.
